rule: A gross error in gate W (ii) is not failed only when it is listed here with a written cause and was reviewed (SPEC gate W). An entry covers its package only while version, frozen lock (sha256 of locks/wild/<id>.json), depfit's four byte fields and both references' four byte fields all equal what was reviewed. Agreement with Vite alone is not a reason: Vite shares depfit's engine.

exceptions.cause: oxc's minifier (Vite 8, depfit) copies the 67,094-character `labelText` string constant into each of its use sites, so the output carries it three times; terser and webpack's minifier keep one binding. Vite 8.3.4 emits the same bytes (vite_anchor). The references are right for their minifiers; depfit is right for Vite. Reviewed: Codex review round 3, 2026-10-16.
